title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Numbers Held for Earlier Facility Letters
content:
A facility-confirmed contact on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile carries, in addition to its scheduled number, the **earlier-letter numbers**: one number for each accepted facility letter on file other than the letter read, up to two.

| Accepted facility letters on file besides the letter read | Earlier-letter numbers |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | 0 |

A facility letter is an accepted supporting document on file about the primary borrower, received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, on a plan whose supporting document setting is none. The letter read is the one received most recently.

*Hypothetical case.* Four accepted facility letters received within the last year: three besides the letter read, held at the maximum of 2.
